buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses STC of this GeM Bid 1. Material is required as per Specification with additional technical requirements. 2. Bidder to read carefully and understand Specification with additional technical requirements a nd then quote in this tender, bidder has to supply material as per BHEL Specification. 3. Bidder has to quote in this tender on FOR-BHEL FSIP JAGDISHPUR STORE BASIS ONLY. 4. CO2 Gas supplied shall be in standard 30 KG Gas cylinder for welding application as per IS307 Grade 1 (For purity of gas minimum 99.7% by volume). 5. PRE-QUALIFYING REQUIREMENT (PQR) is applicable: A. Past Experience: Bidder should have supplied Co2 gas in past 03 (Three) Years (from the last day of the previous month of tender submission). Copies of Purchase Order/ Delivery challan is required to

be submitted as a documentary proof. B. For Manufacturers: Certification/ Declaration of being manufacturer of CO2 gas along with valid ISO 9001 certificate or manufacturing process chart of CO2 gas. OR For Resellers (Trader/Dealer/Distributer/Agent / Stockist etc.) : Authorization letter from their OEM/ Principal / Manufacturer is to be submitted. C. Financial Capability: Average annual financial turnover during the last 03 (Three) financial years ending March’26, at least Rs. 24.37 Lakhs. Turnover Certificate issued by CA having UDIN no. OR Audited Balance Sheet is required to be submitted as a documentary proof. Vendor to submit PQR document along with offer. Bidders who qualifies in above qualifyin g requirement shall be eligible for techno-Commercial evaluation of the offer. Note: Procurement directly from the manufacturers/ suppliers shall be preferred. However, if the OEM/Principal insists on engaging the services of an agent, such agent shall not be allowed to represent more than one manufacturer/supplier in the same tender. Moreover, either the agent could bid on behalf of the manufacturer/ supplier or the manufacturer/supplier could bid directly but not both. In case bids ar e received from both the manufacturer/supplier and the agent, bid received from the agent shall be ignor ed. 6. Delivery of Material: 6.1 1st Lot of 250 cylinders to be supplied on intimation basis, from 2nd lot onward. 125 nos. cylinder to be supplied on intimation basis and supplier shall collect back 125 nos empty cylinder for next s upply. However, the lot size for 2nd lot onward may be changed based on mutual agreement betw een BHEL-FSIP and the Supplier. 6.2 All cylinders shall be on returnable basis i.e. supplier shall collect back all cylinders after completi on of contract. 6.3 Delivery shall be within 3 days on intimation basis through E-mail (excluding date of intimation a nd BHEL-holiday) from the date of intimation through email. Date of receipt of the material at FP BHE L store Jagdishpur shall be treated as date of delivery. The early delivery is also acceptable. 6.4 The intimation shall be raised via email for supply of CO2 gas in cylinder. 6.5 Loading/unloading of cylinders in BHEL-FSIP store will be in supplier’s scope.

7. GST shall be applicable and payable extra, at actual on the date of supply. 8. One cylinder from each consignment shall be taken for testing and approval. CO2 purity test shall be pro vided with each lot/Cylinder. Test certificate in original is required along with material. Three copies of test certificates shall be supplied along with each consignment, giving the following information: a) In addition, the supplier shall ensure to enclose one copy of the test certificate along with the despatch documents to facilitate quick clearance of the material. b) BHEL Order No. c) Batch / Lot No. d) Suppliers/ Manufacturer's Name and Grade e) Test results of Carbon Dioxide 99.7%, min. by volume & Moisture 0.001%, max. by volume. 9. PACKING & MARKING: The gas shall be supplied compressed in cylinders. The design of cylinders, pres sure of gas in cylinders, packing, marking, painting, labelling and transport of cylinders shall be in accorda nce with the 'Gas Cylinder Rules - 1940' of the Government of India with such modifications as may be ord ered from time to time by the Chief Inspector of Explosives, Government of India or other duly constituted authority. The cylinder ground colour shall be black and the cylinder band shall be white or aluminium (as per IS: 5). 10. The cylinders shall also be marked with the BIS certification mark. 11. All cylinders shall be securely tagged with the following information: a) CARBON DIOXIDE GAS – GRADE: 1 (99.7%) b) BHEL Order NO. c) Suppliers / Manufacturer's Name & Grade d) No. of Cylinders e) Net & Gross weight 12. ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS: The supplier shall furnish Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) coveri ng all information relating to human safety and environmental impacts of the hazardous materials particul arly during their transportation, storage, handling and disposal along with each supply. Each container sha ll be marked with corresponding symbol and minimum worded cautionary notice for flammable / corrosive / toxic / harmful / irritant and oxidizing etc. as applicable. 13. LD for delayed performance: If the Seller/Service Provider fails to deliver any or all of the Goods/Servic es within the original/re-fixed delivery period(s) specified in the contract/PO, the Buyer/BHEL will be entitle d to deduct/recover the Liquidated Damages for the delay, unless covered under Force Majeure conditions aforesaid, @ 0.5% of that lot value of delayed quantity per week or part of the week of delayed pe riod as pre-estimated damages not exceeding 10% of the undelivered portion of that lot value without any controversy/dispute of any sort whatsoever. 14. Payment Term: Lot wise Payments shall be made to the Seller within number o f days (as below) from receipt of material subject to acceptance of material at BHEL F SIP Jagdishpur. Type of Bidder Payment Terms (Numbers of days)

Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) 45 DAYS Medium Enterprises 60 DAYS Non MSME 90 DAYS 15. Packing & Forwarding, Freight and Insurance: Packing & Forwarding, Freight and Insurance shall be in vendor's scope. 16. Tolerance in Quantity: After Purchase order placement on eligible bidder, + / - 20% Tolerance in total Purchase order quantity shall be applicable. 17. Test Certificate at the time of supply: Original Test Certificate is required along with supply of materi al for each lot. 18. Tender Quantity consumption: Tender quantity is estimated for 2 years consumption. Contract shall b e effective for 2 years from the date of PO issued. 19. The material shall comply with the requirements of the following national standard and also meet the requi rements of this specification IS : 307 – 1966, Gr.: 1. 20. Carbon Dioxide (Appendix A-2 of IS: 307 or Gas chromatograph): 99.7%, min. by volume. 21. Moisture (Appendix A-6 of IS: 307 or Dew point) : 0.001%, max. by volume. 22. This CO2 gas is required for MIG welding machine as shop consumables in Fabrication shop. .
